quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a continuous glucose monitor designed for people without diabetes who want to optimise energy.
quests.correctAnswer: Our monitor shows how everyday foods affect your blood sugar in real time - helping anyone optimise energy and focus without a single blood test.
quests.hint: Reframe clinical technology for a mainstream wellness audience.
quests.explanation: Repositioning medical technology for wellness dramatically expands the addressable market beyond patients.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wearable device that detects early dehydration before you feel thirsty.
quests.correctAnswer: Our wristband monitors hydration at a cellular level and alerts you before you feel thirsty - preventing the energy drop that dehydration causes.
quests.hint: Lead with the pre-symptom early warning.
quests.explanation: Preventing a problem before the user notices is a highly persuasive health positioning.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home blood pressure monitor that sends readings directly to your GP.
quests.correctAnswer: Our monitor takes your blood pressure and sends the reading to your doctor automatically - keeping your health team informed without booking a single appointment.
quests.hint: Highlight the seamless connection to clinical care.
quests.explanation: Connecting home monitoring to clinical care removes friction from long-term health management for patients and doctors.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a daily personalised vitamin pack delivered in single-dose sachets based on your blood test.
quests.correctAnswer: Our daily sachets deliver exactly the vitamins your blood test shows you need - personalised nutrition in one easy pouch each morning.
quests.hint: Lead with the blood test-based personalisation as the science.
quests.explanation: Science-backed personalisation positions this product far above standard supplement brands.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a plant-based protein powder with no artificial sweeteners flavours or fillers.
quests.correctAnswer: Our protein powder uses only whole plant ingredients with nothing artificial - clean fuel that actually tastes good unlike most of the market.
quests.hint: Contrast clean ingredients against the common industry alternatives.
quests.explanation: Positioning against artificial ingredients in a crowded supplement market creates instant differentiation.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a nutrition app that scans barcodes and builds your daily nutrient profile in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app scans any product barcode and builds a live picture of every nutrient you eat throughout the day - nutritional awareness that requires no effort.
quests.hint: Emphasise the ease of scanning and the comprehensive picture it builds.
quests.explanation: Effortless scanning combined with comprehensive tracking lowers the barrier to genuine nutritional awareness.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart gym mirror that streams live fitness classes and corrects your form using AI.
quests.correctAnswer: Our mirror streams live classes into your living room and uses your camera to correct your form in real time - a gym and a personal trainer in one device.
quests.hint: Highlight the real-time form correction as the unique value.
quests.explanation: Real-time form correction at home is the missing ingredient that makes home workouts as effective as gym sessions.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a recovery app for athletes that tracks sleep training and nutrition together.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app combines sleep quality training load and nutrition data to tell athletes exactly when their body is ready to perform at its best.
quests.hint: Focus on the integrated readiness insight it produces.
quests.explanation: Integrated readiness scores are what elite sports teams use - now available in a consumer product.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a corporate wellness platform replacing generic gym memberships with personalised health goals.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform replaces one-size gym memberships with personalised daily health goals tracked and rewarded so every employee feels genuinely motivated.
quests.hint: Contrast personalisation directly with the generic gym membership.
quests.explanation: Personalised workplace wellness is a high-growth B2B market as employers compete harder for talent.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital journalling app that uses AI to identify your emotional patterns over time.
quests.correctAnswer: Our journalling app reads your entries over months and reveals the emotional patterns you never noticed yourself - self-awareness that builds without any effort.
quests.hint: Lead with the long-term pattern insight as the unique value.
quests.explanation: Long-term emotional pattern recognition offers a uniquely valuable mirror that no single therapy session provides.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app connecting people with shared anxiety triggers for peer support.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app matches people who share the same anxiety triggers so they can support each other through a safe and private network - real help from people who truly understand.
quests.hint: Highlight the peer matching and the safety of the environment.
quests.explanation: Peer support for mental health reduces stigma and provides authentic connection that clinical apps rarely achieve.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a corporate mental health platform providing anonymous therapy sessions for all employees.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform gives every employee access to anonymous therapy sessions at any time - removing the stigma of seeking help that prevents most people from ever trying.
quests.hint: Lead with anonymity and the stigma reduction as the unlock.
quests.explanation: Anonymity is the single most important unlock for mental health benefits adoption in any workplace.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart mattress that adjusts its firmness throughout the night based on your sleep position.
quests.correctAnswer: Our mattress detects how you sleep and adjusts firmness automatically all night long - perfect spinal support whether you sleep on your back side or front.
quests.hint: Lead with the adaptive intelligence and the benefit.
quests.explanation: A mattress that adapts automatically removes the impossible task of choosing a firmness level in a shop.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a bedside device that tracks sleep stages and wakes you at the optimal moment in your cycle.
quests.correctAnswer: Our device tracks your sleep stages and wakes you during light sleep so you rise feeling genuinely refreshed rather than dragged out of deep sleep.
quests.hint: Focus on the quality of waking up as the experience.
quests.explanation: Waking at the right sleep stage is directly linked to morning energy - a universal and immediately understood desire.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cooling blanket that regulates temperature using breathable thermal fabric.
quests.correctAnswer: Our blanket draws heat away from your body using thermal fibres - staying perfectly cool all night without needing any air conditioning.
quests.hint: Highlight the passive technology that requires no power.
quests.explanation: Passive temperature regulation appeals to comfort seekers and eco-conscious consumers simultaneously.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an electric toothbrush that maps every tooth and shows which spots you keep missing.
quests.correctAnswer: Our toothbrush maps your entire mouth and shows you exactly which teeth you keep skipping - perfect brushing habits built without any guesswork.
quests.hint: Lead with the precision mouth map and the habit-building outcome.
quests.explanation: Visual feedback on brushing behaviour changes habits more effectively than simple timer-based alerts alone.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a water flosser with a built-in mouthwash dispenser for complete oral hygiene in one step.
quests.correctAnswer: Our water flosser cleans between every tooth and releases mouthwash simultaneously - complete oral hygiene in one device with half the steps.
quests.hint: Highlight the two-in-one step simplification.
quests.explanation: Combining oral hygiene steps into one increases compliance by reducing the effort required.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a teeth whitening kit calibrated to your natural enamel shade for a truly natural result.
quests.correctAnswer: Our whitening kit analyses your enamel shade and whitens precisely to your natural ideal - a beautiful result with none of the artificial over-whitened look.
quests.hint: Lead with the promise of a natural result.
quests.explanation: Natural-looking results address the fear of over-whitening that prevents many people from trying whitening products.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch smart glasses that automatically adjust their tint based on light conditions around you.
quests.correctAnswer: Our glasses automatically darken in sunlight and clear indoors - one pair that works perfectly in every light without any manual adjustment.
quests.hint: Highlight the effortless light adaptation.
quests.explanation: Eliminating the need to switch between glasses pairs is an obvious and immediate convenience for glasses wearers.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a contact lens subscription service that includes a free annual eye test.
quests.correctAnswer: Our subscription delivers fresh contacts every month and includes an annual eye test - complete vision care in one simple plan at a clear monthly price.
quests.hint: Combine the product with the included annual clinical care.
quests.explanation: Bundling eye tests with contact lens delivery creates a comprehensive service that is genuinely hard to match.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a blue light filter screen protector designed specifically for remote workers.
quests.correctAnswer: Our screen protector blocks harmful blue light and reduces digital eye strain so remote workers can focus for longer without headaches or tired eyes.
quests.hint: Target the specific remote worker screen pain point.
quests.explanation: Screen-related eye strain is a universal remote work complaint - solving it has a large and obvious audience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI skincare advisor that analyses your skin from a single selfie.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app analyses your skin from one selfie and recommends the exact products your specific skin actually needs - personalised skincare in sixty seconds.
quests.hint: Lead with the selfie-based speed of the diagnosis.
quests.explanation: Skincare diagnosis from a selfie democratises dermatology and removes the guesswork from product selection.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a refillable skincare system that cuts plastic waste by ninety per cent.
quests.correctAnswer: Our refillable pods cut plastic packaging by ninety per cent - premium skincare you can feel genuinely good about buying.
quests.hint: Use the specific ninety per cent figure to make the claim concrete.
quests.explanation: Specific numbers make environmental claims credible and memorable rather than vague and forgettable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a UV tracking sticker that warns you when you need to reapply sunscreen.
quests.correctAnswer: Our skin sticker changes colour as UV exposure builds and alerts you before you burn - smart sun protection for every skin type in every climate.
quests.hint: Emphasise the proactive warning before any burning occurs.
quests.explanation: Preventing burn before it happens is a more compelling safety pitch than treating it afterwards.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a portable air quality monitor for people living in polluted cities.
quests.correctAnswer: Our pocket monitor measures air quality wherever you are in real time and warns you before pollution levels become dangerous to breathe.
quests.hint: Lead with the real-time personal exposure data.
quests.explanation: Personal exposure data makes invisible pollution immediately personal and actionable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an inhaler tracking app that monitors usage patterns for asthma patients.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app logs every inhaler use and shares the pattern with your doctor so your asthma treatment is always based on what is actually happening.
quests.hint: Highlight the doctor-shared pattern as the clinical value.
quests.explanation: Usage pattern data shared with clinicians dramatically improves asthma management between appointments.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch invisible nasal filters that block allergens in high pollen environments.
quests.correctAnswer: Our invisible nasal filters block ninety-eight per cent of pollen without the social awkwardness of wearing a face mask in public.
quests.hint: Lead with invisibility and the high efficacy percentage.
quests.explanation: Invisibility addresses the social barrier that prevents many people from wearing any pollen protection at all.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital health passport storing your complete medical records in one secure app.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app stores your complete medical history securely in one place - ready to share with any doctor anywhere in the world the moment it is needed.
quests.hint: Highlight the global portability and the instant sharing.
quests.explanation: Global medical record portability is increasingly important as people travel and change healthcare providers frequently.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a remote monitoring platform for patients with chronic heart conditions.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform continuously monitors heart patients between clinic visits and alerts their care team to any warning sign - protection during the most vulnerable gap in care.
quests.hint: Lead with the continuous between-visit monitoring.
quests.explanation: Continuous monitoring between clinic visits fills the most dangerous gap in chronic disease management.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a medication management app that prevents dangerous interactions between drugs.
quests.correctAnswer: Our app checks every new prescription against all your current medicines and flags dangerous interactions before you take anything - preventing harm before it happens.
quests.hint: Stress the prevention and the safety.
quests.explanation: Preventing medication errors is a life-safety pitch that requires no further justification to any patient or carer.
